headline: Tampa have now won as often as they have lost
dek: Tampa's win at Embry-Riddle brings them to six wins and six defeats, with four draws besides. Embry-Riddle, who won at Tampa earlier in the season, have not won since they beat Saint Leo.
displaced_by: results night: Tampa's win at Embry-Riddle levels their record
